title.note: Game title, glossary keep: stays in Latin, as the guide keeps game titles.

hud.cast.note: Fishing verb 'забацити' (throw the line out), not a spell or a movie cast.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull it out' (land the fish); same verb as the Auto Reel pass (Аутоизвлачење).

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1, 2 and 5 all read right; '{count} мамаца' breaks at 1 and 21.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern: no gendered 'Уловио/ла си' and no {rarity} adjective before {fish}, which could not agree with a feminine fish like Јегуља-фењер.

catch.escaped.note: Names the generic fish so the feminine past tense agrees with 'риба'; single ellipsis character per the guide.

catch.new_record.note: Cyrillic 'кг'. For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4' but Serbian writes '12,4', so format it per LocaleId in game code.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name kept as 'eel-lantern', the Serbian head-first apposition pattern (like 'човек-паук'); keeps the lantern idea. Alternative: 'Фењерска јегуља'.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier tag like 'Легендарни', per the guide; reads as above Legendary.

shop.rods.note: 'Пецаљка' is specifically a fishing rod; 'Штапови' would be any sticks or poles.

shop.equipped.note: State form agreeing with the feminine 'пецаљка' it labels; 'У употреби' (10) is the neutral fallback if the label ever goes on other items.

shop.free.note: Standard Serbian price word for 'free of charge'; 'Бесплатно' is more common in UI but is 9 letters against a budget of 8. Use it if the price slot has room.

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux stays Latin and undeclined after a number (guide).

pass.auto_reel.note: Verbal noun of the hud.reel verb 'извући' with the prefix 'ауто-' written solid, as Serbian spelling does; 13/14. The Creator Hub store name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Мамац среће удвостручује шансу за ретке рибе!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Мамац среће' follows Minecraft's Serbian 'Напитак среће'; 'your' dropped per the guide's no-possessive rule.

sell.done.note: Label form for both numbers: '{count} риба' and '{coins} новчића' are wrong at 1 and 21. Reads 'Fish sold: 12, coins earned: 340!'.

sell.prompt.note: Latin E kept; no comma before the 'да' clause (guide). 20/21.

ascend.button.note: 'Rise up': prestige sense, not religious ('вазнести се') and not climbing ('попни се'). Exactly 10/10, so check it fits the button.

ascend.confirm.text: Желиш ли да се уздигнеш сада? Почећеш испочетка, али ћеш ловити ретке рибе {bonus}% чешће.
ascend.confirm.note: Same verb as ascend.button; future tense keeps it gender-neutral; percent with no space (CLDR).

weather.storm.note: 'Риба гризе' is the everyday angler's phrase for fish taking the bait.

quest.catch_n.note: Target number after a colon so n = 1, 2 and 5 all read right ('{n} риба' breaks at 1 and 2-4). Place name 'Залив месечине' (Bay of Moonlight) in the locative; in-world signs should match.

friends.boost.note: Genitive after the percent, as in '20% попуста'.

trade.sent.note: Username stays undeclined after the head noun 'играчу' (guide); passive avoids a gendered 'Послао/ла си'. 32/33.

trade.accept.note: Verb agrees with the fixed noun 'играч', so it is right for any player; 'your' dropped per the guide.

afk.kicked.text: Предуго те није било, па је пецање прекинуто.
afk.kicked.note: Impersonal 'you were gone too long' avoids the gendered 'Био/ла си неактиван/на'; no mention of removal from the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: 'Lasts {time} more', the guide's countdown pattern. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h', which mixes Latin into Serbian; a LocaleId-aware formatter should print '2 д 4 ч'.

daily.streak.text: {day}. дан заредом! Врати се сутра по нове награде.
daily.streak.note: Ordinal '{day}.' avoids plural forms for any day count; 'for more' made explicit as 'new rewards'.

tip.night.text: Савет: неке рибе гризу само ноћу.

group.join.text: Придружи се групи и добиј 50 бесплатних мамаца!
group.join.note: The fixed 50 takes the genitive plural 'мамаца'. 'Група' is the Roblox group word.

leaderboard.biggest.note: The usual angler phrase, judged by weight; 'Најтежи улов' is the literal alternative.
